```plato

    // Where the segment (a, b) meets the plane. Meaningful only when the
    // endpoints lie strictly on opposite sides (the interpolant is then in
    // (0, 1)); a same-side or coplanar segment yields an unusable point the
    // caller must drop.
    CrossingPoint(pl: Plane, a: Point3D, b: Point3D): Point3D
        => a.Lerp(b, pl.SignedDistance(a) / (pl.SignedDistance(a) - pl.SignedDistance(b)));
```
